# Hono API

<!-- Generated by fixtures/apps.ts from the files in this directory. Edit those, then regenerate. -->

A small REST API written with Hono, one Lambda function behind an HTTP API: a greeting at `/`, a list of posts at `GET /posts`, and `POST /posts`. Its only dependency is `hono`, which makes it the smallest application here and the closest to what a first Lambda API looks like.

The application is Stacktape's starter project `hono-api` (`apps/cli/starter-projects/` in the Stacktape repository), in `app/`. Changes from the starter:

- Every direct dependency is pinned to an exact version, the newest within the starter's own range.

The incremental measurement changes one line of `src/index.ts`, from `'Hello from Hono on AWS Lambda!'` to `'Hello from Hono on AWS Lambda, edited!'`, and packages again.

`lib/hono-api-stack.ts`, 25 lines

```ts
import * as cdk from 'aws-cdk-lib/core';
import { CorsHttpMethod, HttpApi } from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-apigatewayv2';
import { HttpLambdaIntegration } from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-apigatewayv2-integrations';
import { Runtime } from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-lambda';
import { NodejsFunction } from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-lambda-nodejs';
import { Construct } from 'constructs';

export class HonoApiStack extends cdk.Stack {
  constructor(scope: Construct, id: string, props?: cdk.StackProps) {
    super(scope, id, props);

    const api = new NodejsFunction(this, 'Api', {
      entry: 'src/index.ts',
      runtime: Runtime.NODEJS_24_X,
      memorySize: 512
    });

    const httpApi = new HttpApi(this, 'HttpApi', {
      defaultIntegration: new HttpLambdaIntegration('ApiIntegration', api),
      corsPreflight: { allowOrigins: ['*'], allowMethods: [CorsHttpMethod.ANY], allowHeaders: ['*'] }
    });

    new cdk.CfnOutput(this, 'ApiUrl', { value: httpApi.apiEndpoint });
  }
}
```

    handler: src/index.handler

`sst.config.ts`, 19 lines

```ts
/// <reference path="./.sst/platform/config.d.ts" />

export default $config({
  app(input) {
    return {
      name: 'hono-api',
      removal: input?.stage === 'production' ? 'retain' : 'remove',
      protect: ['production'].includes(input?.stage),
      home: 'aws',
      providers: { aws: { region: 'eu-west-1' } }
    };
  },
  async run() {
    const api = new sst.aws.ApiGatewayV2('ApiGateway');
    api.route('$default', { handler: 'src/index.handler', memory: '512 MB' });

    return { url: api.url };
  }
});
```
